summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K to respond to a news report about a potential investment in Rakuten Bank. The filing states that no decision has been made, and any investment is under examination following Rakuten's February 25, 2026 announcement about discussions. No terms, price, premium, or advisors are disclosed. This is a non-US filing (Japan) disclosed as a 6-K; it is not a definitive agreement or formal special situation event. What to watch: whether Mizuho confirms an investment or the talks collapse.
